notes.subject: job 6:14 syntax
notes.rationale: KJV/ASV read 'even to him who forsakes the fear of Shaday'; YLT reads 'he who despises his friends forsakes the fear of Shaday' — antithesis ambiguous

notes.subject: hesed
notes.rationale: חסד kept as hesed per discipline; single Bambara word would narrow it

notes.subject: nka
notes.rationale: connector supplied to carry the ambiguous Hebrew conjunction

translation: Tɛgɛntigi ma, a tɔgɔma ka hesed di; nka min y'a to, o bɛ Shaday sirani bali.
